# pulp Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "pulp" {
  server_url = "http://localhost:8080"
  username   = "admin"
  password   = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `force_ipv4` (Boolean) Whether to force the provider to use IPv4 when connecting to the Pulp API. May also be provided via `PULP_FORCE_IPV4` environment variable.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for Pulp API. May also be provided via the `PULP_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `server_url` (String) URI for Pulp API. May also be provided via the `PULP_SERVER_URL` environment variable.
- `username` (String) Username for Pulp API. May also be provided via the `PULP_USERNAME` environment variable.
